name: Takatsuki Reiji
source:
"Your smile calms my heart."

Appears 24 years old, actual age unknown.
The school health doctor at Onigasato High School, he's one of the 'Three Wings' underneath [url=/c44373]Kaki[/url].
He's also known as the 'Beauty of the Infirmary' who boasts of a beauty that transcends gender.
